build_HiFiCAutoencoder: build a HiFiC autoencoder model with configurable latent features and residual blocks for image compression
compress_images_with_HiFiCAutoencoder: compress a batch of images into entropy-coded strings using the HiFiC autoencoder compress method
decompress_images_with_HiFiCAutoencoder: decompress entropy-coded strings back into reconstructed images using the HiFiC autoencoder decompress method
freeze_HiFiCAutoencoder_encoder: freeze the encoder weights of a HiFiC autoencoder to disable gradient updates during training
update_tensor_devices_HiFiCAutoencoder: update tensor device placement for forward or compress operations on the HiFiC autoencoder model
